sponsored.t: Prohibits retaliation by cooperative housing programs against shareholders
sponsored.sum: Prohibits cooperative housing programs from engaging in adverse actions and retaliation against shareholders.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for the appointment of a guardian for personal needs or property management
sponsored.sum: Provides for requirements for the appointment of a guardian for personal needs or property management; requires financial institutions to provide all necessary bank statements for a Medicaid application to a requesting department of social services or other state or local agency administering public assistance or medical assistance within a reasonable amount of time of receipt of such request; requires a banking organization, branch in this state of an out-of-state bank or foreign banking corporation to provide such records within thirty days of receipt of such request.
sponsored.fis: No fiscal implications. This bill is changing statute and should not require any funding.

sponsored.t: Suspends all unnecessary travel to states that permit discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression
sponsored.sum: Suspends all unnecessary travel to states that have enacted a law that voids or repeals, or has the effect of voiding or repealing, existing state or local protections against discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression or have enacted a law that authorizes or requires discrimination against same-sex couples or their families or on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression, including any law that creates an exemption to anti-discrimination laws in order to permit discrimination against same-sex couples or their families or on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression.

sponsored.t: Extends the twenty-five year presumptive eligibility period for certain retirement benefits for injuries or illnesses related to World Trade Center rescue, recovery and clean-up operations
sponsored.sum: Extends the presumptive eligibility period, from twenty-five to thirty-five years, for certain retirement benefits for injuries or illnesses related to World Trade Center rescue, recovery and clean-up operations.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability claims for a qualifying World Trade Center
sponsored.sum: Extends the deadline for filing disability claims for a qualifying World Trade Center condition until 2030.

sponsored.t: Relates to notice of applications for major capital improvement rent increases
sponsored.sum: Requires notice of applications for major capital improvement rent increases to include a statement on the first page explaining in plain language the tenant's right to answer or reply and how a tenant may request an extension of time to submit such answer or reply.

sponsored.t: Sets standards for advertising deeply affordable housing
sponsored.sum: Sets standards for advertising deeply affordable housing.
sponsored.fis: Minimal, as enforcement will fall under existing regulatory frameworks.

sponsored.t: Directs the office of the state comptroller to conduct a study on establishing a universal pension system
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of the state comptroller to conduct a study on establishing a universal pension system in the state of New York; requires the office of the state comptroller to submit a report of such study.

sponsored.t: Relates to the compensation, benefits and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the compensation, benefits and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; implements the agreements between the state and the public employees federation.
sponsored.fis: This bill would provide appropriations totaling approximately $333 million to pay for the cost of the Agreement during the period April 2, 2026 to March 31, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to service of certain notice of violations returnable to the environmental control board
sponsored.sum: Provides for service of notice of violations of any provision of title sixteen of the administrative code of the city of New York by the department of sanitation on a respondent that is a closed commercial establishment.

sponsored.t: Relates to education transportation contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to employment contracts between school bus workers and the department of education in a city with at least one million inhabitants.

sponsored.t: Designates certain traffic enforcement agents as peace officers
sponsored.sum: Designates all agents employed by the city of New York police department in the titles of traffic enforcement agent I and traffic enforcement agent II as peace officers.

sponsored.t: Permits assessment of certain fees and costs upon wrongful denial of access to records under the freedom of information law
sponsored.sum: Permits assessment of certain fees and costs upon wrongful denial of access to records under the freedom of information law when either the person has substantially prevailed, or if the agency failed to respond within the statutory time.
sponsored.fis: The long-term effect of this bill should result in savings for the state and local governments. The assessment of attorney's fees and costs against public agencies should encourage them to grant access to public records-since denial without a reasonable basis in law could result in a significant expenditure. Moreover, the assessment of fees and liti- gation costs under specific circumstances could increase the likelihood of settlements of disputes without court involvement and encourage reli- ance on the Committee on Open Government for advice or as a mediator in a dispute.

sponsored.t: Repeals a provision of the civil service law relating to resolutions of disputes in the course of collective negotiations with certain deputy sheriffs
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to resolutions of disputes in the course of collective negotiations with certain deputy sheriffs to provide such deputy sheriffs with the same interest arbitration scope as municipal police officers.

sponsored.t: Grants certain county fire marshals, supervising fire marshals, fire marshals, assistant fire marshals, assistant chief fire marshals or chief fire marshals pension benefits for service beyond twenty-five years
sponsored.sum: Grants Nassau county fire marshals, supervising fire marshals, fire marshals, assistant fire marshals, assistant chief fire marshals or chief fire marshals pension benefits for service rendered beyond twenty-five years.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability benefits for certain individuals employed by the Nassau county police department
sponsored.sum: Provides a performance of duty presumption for diseases of the heart for members who serve as an ambulance medical technician, ambulance medical coordinator, ambulance medical technician/supervisor or a member who performs ambulance medical technician related services, or a police medic, police medic coordinator, police medic supervisor, bureau director police emergency ambulance services - county, assistant bureau director police emergency ambulance services - county, or a member who performs police medic or police emergency ambulance related services and is employed in the Nassau county police department.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effective date of a reclassification for an accidental disability retirement benefit
sponsored.sum: Relates to the effective date of a reclassification for an accidental disability retirement benefit for applications filed on or after January 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Provides for compensation and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Provides for compensation and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; authorizes funding of joint labor-management committees; implements agreements between the state and an employee organization; makes an appropriation therefor (Part A); provides for the salaries of certain state officers and employees excluded from collective negotiating units; makes an appropriation therefor (Part B).
sponsored.fis: Part A of the bill would provide appropriations totaling approximately $219 million to pay for the cost of the negotiated Agreement during the period April 2, 2026 to March 31, 2027. Part B of the bill would provide appropriations totaling approximately $112 million to pay its cost during the period April 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement benefits for uniformed sanitation members of the New York city employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Provides that for New York city uniformed sanitation revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement benefits for uniformed correction members of the New York city employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Provides that for New York city uniformed correction revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

sponsored.t: Permits New York city correction and sanitation members to borrow from accumulated contributions; repealer
sponsored.sum: Permits New York City correction and sanitation members to borrow from accumulated contributions to their retirement plans.

sponsored.t: Requires utilities accept public assistance payments
sponsored.sum: Requires utilities accept public assistance payments including payments from the home energy assistance programs and emergency funding programs.

sponsored.t: Provides for eligibility of certain participants in the New York City employees retirement system to opt into the twenty-five year retirement program for EMT members
sponsored.sum: Provides for eligibility of certain participants in the New York City employees retirement system to opt into the twenty-five year retirement program for EMT members.

sponsored.t: Provides for a disability retirement for certain deputy sheriff members of a retirement system in certain cities
sponsored.sum: Provides for a line of duty disability presumption for any condition of impairment of health caused by diseases of the lung, resulting in total or partial disability or death of certain deputy sheriff members of a retirement system in certain cities.

sponsored.t: Provides for a line of duty presumption for disabilities of deputy sheriffs in certain cities
sponsored.sum: Provides for a line of duty presumption for disabilities of deputy sheriffs in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to age and service eligibility requirements for ordinary retirement for members of the unified court system
sponsored.sum: Relates to age and service eligibility requirements for ordinary retirement for members of the unified court system; restores 55/30 for all members; reduces the retirement age from 63 to 62.

sponsored.t: Relates to the installation of appliances or fixtures by tenants
sponsored.sum: Prohibits landlords from restricting the installation of appliances or fixtures by tenants; provides that the landlord is not compelled to change utilities or alter the unit for such installation; prohibits surcharge where tenant pays utilities directly to provider; requires a tenant restore appliances or fixtures to the condition they were prior to being installed or allowing such appliances or fixtures remain in the rental unit at no cost to the landlord; defines "appliances or fixtures".

sponsored.t: Provides a heart disease presumption for certain members employed as probation officers
sponsored.sum: Provides a heart disease presumption for members employed as a probation officer, supervising probation officer or probation officer trainee of a department of probation in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Provides for the transfer of service credit between certain retirement systems
sponsored.sum: Provides for the transfer of service credit by a member of the New York city police pension fund into the New York city police pension fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with street cleaning parking rules
sponsored.sum: Relates to owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with street cleaning parking rules; relates to access to records prepared pursuant to street cleaning parking rules.

sponsored.t: Requires body armor worn by New York city emergency services personnel to be replaced every five years
sponsored.sum: Requires body armor worn by New York city emergency services personnel to be replaced every five years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the ordinary disability benefit for enhanced plan members of the New York city fire department pension fund
sponsored.sum: Provides an ordinary disability benefit for tier 3 enhanced plan members of the New York city fire department pension fund which is equivalent to the tier 2 benefit.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 190th street subway station on the IND Eighth Avenue line to the 190th street Fort Tryon Park station
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 190th street subway station on the IND Eighth Avenue line to the 190th street - Fort Tryon Park station.

sponsored.t: Updates the definition of cyberbullying in the dignity for all students act
sponsored.sum: Updates the definition of cyberbullying in the dignity for all students act to include intentionally using artificial intelligence to mimic or alter a person's likeness or voice without their consent.

sponsored.t: Provides for prior service credit for county fire marshals in the county of Nassau
sponsored.sum: Provides for prior service credit for county fire marshals in the county of Nassau for service as a forest ranger I, forest ranger II, forest ranger III, assistant superintendent of forest fire control, or any successor titles or new titles in the forest ranger title series in the department of environmental conservation, as a police officer in the department of environmental conservation, as a park police officer trainee, park police office, sergeant park police, lieutenant park police, major park police, or any successor titles or new titles in the park police title series in the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation or other state park authority or commission, as a member…

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring thirty days notice be provided to tenants prior to the beginning of work on a major capital improvement
sponsored.sum: Requires thirty days notice be provided to tenants prior to the beginning of work on a major capital improvement.

sponsored.t: Relates to staffing standards for employees performing emergency medical services in the 911 system in a city with a population of over one million people
sponsored.sum: Sets minimum staffing standards for employees performing emergency medical services in the 911 system in a city with a population of over one million people.

sponsored.t: Relates to making a city school district in a city having a population of one million or more eligible for transitional aid for charter school payments
sponsored.sum: Relates to making a city school district in a city having a population of one million or more eligible for transitional aid for charter school payments.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain surcharges on self-installed dishwashers in housing accommodations subject to rent control
sponsored.sum: Prohibits surcharges on self-installed dishwashers in housing accommodations subject to rent control when the tenant pays for electric utility service.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner to convene statewide and regional conventions to bring together underrepresented educators
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner to convene statewide and regional conventions to bring together underrepresented educators annually to discuss experiences, best practices, and afford for networking, mentorship opportunities, and support.

sponsored.t: Provides a heart disease presumption for certain members employed as fire alarm dispatchers
sponsored.sum: Provides a heart disease presumption for members employed as a fire alarm dispatcher, a supervising fire alarm dispatcher level one or a supervising fire alarm dispatcher level two of a fire department in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Dutchess to offer an optional twenty-five year retirement plan to certain deputy sheriffs employed by such county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Dutchess to offer an optional twenty-five year retirement plan to certain deputy sheriffs employed by such county.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of additional member contributions and basic member contributions for certain retirement system members to allow such contributions to be used as offsets
sponsored.sum: Modifies the definition of additional member contributions and basic member contributions for certain New York city employees' retirement system members who are subject to the twenty-five year retirement program for fire protection inspector members under Article 15 of the retirement and social security law, to allow such additional member contributions to be used to offset a deficit of basic member contributions, or to allow an excess of basic member contributions to offset a deficit of additional member contributions.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement of uniformed members of the New York city fire department pension fund
sponsored.sum: Removes the twenty-five year requirement for service retirement of certain uniformed members of the New York city fire department pension fund.

sponsored.t: Permits certain twenty-five year retirement program dispatcher members to file elections not to participate
sponsored.sum: Permits certain twenty-five year retirement program dispatcher members to file elections not to participate.

sponsored.t: Establishes a twenty year retirement option for certain deputy sheriffs employed by the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes a twenty year retirement option for certain deputy sheriffs employed by the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Permits surviving spouses of certain members to retain accidental death benefits upon remarriage
sponsored.sum: Permits surviving spouses of certain members to retain accidental death benefits upon remarriage; provides for regaining of any such lost benefits prior to the rule change.

sponsored.t: Relates to longevity bonuses for members of the uniformed service with the New York city fire department
sponsored.sum: Provides for salary bonuses for members of the uniformed service with the New York city fire department who retire with at least twenty-five, thirty or thirty-five years of service, including an additional bonus for each year after year twenty-five.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement of members of the New York city fire department pension fund
sponsored.sum: Provides for escalation payments for certain members of the New York city fire department pension fund.

sponsored.t: Prohibits residential landlords from charging tenants with fees for the payment of rent through an automated clearing house or online payment system
sponsored.sum: Prohibits residential landlords from charging tenants with fees for the payment of rent through an automated clearing house or online payment system.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing increases of cost-of-living adjustments
sponsored.sum: Provides increases of cost-of-living adjustments for public retirees; allows increases of up to five percent.

sponsored.t: Relates to employee mental health services
sponsored.sum: Establishes an employee mental health services program for all employees who work for the department of corrections and community supervision and all employees of the office of mental health who deliver services to incarcerated individuals overseen by the department of corrections and community supervision.

sponsored.t: Provides for network participation verification and disclosure
sponsored.sum: Requires health care providers to verify and disclose their in- or out-of-network status with a prospective patient's health plan.

sponsored.t: Includes a statement on the envelopes of ballots for early mail voters, absentee voters and special presidential voters for signature affirmation
sponsored.sum: Includes a statement on the envelopes of ballots for early mail voters, absentee voters and special presidential voters for signature affirmation.

sponsored.t: Provides for retirement credit to fire protection inspector members for a child care leave of absence
sponsored.sum: Provides for retirement credit to fire protection inspector members for a child care leave of absence.

sponsored.t: Provides for retirement credit to emergency medical technicians and advanced emergency medical technicians for a child care leave of absence
sponsored.sum: Provides for retirement credit to emergency medical technicians and advanced emergency medical technicians for a child care leave of absence.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility for the tuition assistance program
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility for the tuition assistance program by restoring eligibility to graduate students; makes optional semesters, quarters or terms eligible for awards.

sponsored.t: Relates to applying cost-of-living adjustments
sponsored.sum: Provides a cost-of-living adjustment for New York public retirement systems.

sponsored.t: Provides for cost of living adjustments for certain retirees
sponsored.sum: Decreases the time period before certain retirees receive a cost of living adjustment to their benefits.

sponsored.t: Directs the president of the state civil service commission to conduct a study on job vacancies across state agencies
sponsored.sum: Directs the president of the state civil service commission to conduct a study on job vacancies across state agencies and determine which, if any, state agencies are understaffed.

sponsored.t: Provides cost-of-living adjustments for certain public retirees
sponsored.sum: Provides cost-of-living adjustments for certain public retirees, including an adjusted benefit in monthly installments that is equal to the percentage of the change in consumer price index according to the included schedule.

sponsored.t: Provides for a heart disease presumption for certain New York police department traffic enforcement agents
sponsored.sum: Provides for a heart disease presumption for certain New York police department traffic enforcement agents.

sponsored.t: Provides minimum basic training related to handling emergency situations involving individuals with any physical and/or developmental disability to all firefighters
sponsored.sum: Empowers the office of fire prevention and control to, in coordination with the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities and the chief disability officer, provide minimum basic training related to handling emergency situations involving individuals with any physical and/or developmental disability to all firefighters.

sponsored.t: Increases the cap on the credit for contributions to certain funds for contributions to the SUNY Impact Foundation to twenty million dollars
sponsored.sum: Increases the cap on the credit for contributions to certain funds for contributions to the SUNY Impact Foundation from ten million dollars to twenty million dollars.
sponsored.fis: Increasing the cap from $10 million to $20 million will result in a higher annual fiscal impact due to the expanded availability of tax credits. However, the economic benefits from increased private donations to CUNY and SUNY institutions, funding scholarships, research, and facilities, are expected to provide substantial returns to the state.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of most artificial intelligence in classrooms prior to high school
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of most artificial intelligence in classrooms prior to high school except for AI used for diagnostic purposes or explicit instruction interventions for students with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Provides for presumptions for certain impairments of health
sponsored.sum: Provides for performance of duty presumptions for HIV, tuberculosis and hepatitis for certain Nassau county positions.

sponsored.t: Provides for a performance and discharge of duty presumption for certain impairments of health of Nassau county fire marshals
sponsored.sum: Provides for a performance and discharge of duty presumption for diseases of the lung of Nassau county fire marshals.

sponsored.t: Relates to article 78 judgments regarding disability pension determinations
sponsored.sum: Permits court ruling in favor of a petitioner appealing the denial of a disability pension determination to grant disability pension.

sponsored.t: Affords certain members of the fire department pension fund with new or increased pension benefits for each year of additional service beyond their required minimum service
sponsored.sum: Affords certain members of the fire department pension fund with new or increased pension benefits for each year of additional service beyond their required minimum service.

sponsored.t: Changes the due date by which the New York State teachers' retirement system is required to submit the annual MWBE report
sponsored.sum: Changes the due date by which the New York State teachers' retirement system is required to submit the annual MWBE report to on or before December thirty-first following the end of the teachers retirement system's fiscal year.

sponsored.t: Relates to owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with street cleaning parking rules
sponsored.sum: Relates to owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with street cleaning parking rules; relates to access to records prepared pursuant to street cleaning parking rules.

sponsored.t: Relates to the election to have federal and/or state income tax deducted and withheld from an individual's unemployment insurance benefits
sponsored.sum: Relates to the election to have federal and/or state income tax deducted and withheld from an individual's unemployment insurance benefits.

sponsored.t: Relates to the transfer of reserves between public employee retirement systems of the state
sponsored.sum: Provides for transfers from the MTA police retirement program to certain other retirement systems or funds.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a claimant to receive a dependent allowance in addition to unemployment insurance benefits
sponsored.sum: Provides that a claimant eligible to receive unemployment insurance benefits shall also be entitled to receive a dependent allowance which shall begin at forty-five dollars and shall increase annually by an amount determined by the department of labor; directs the department of labor to report to the legislature following each calendar quarter certain information about dependent allowances and to make such reports available on its website; provides that a claimant's maximum benefit amount, including such dependent allowance, shall not exceed one hundred percent of such claimant's average weekly wage from their highest-earning calendar quarter.

sponsored.t: Requires training of teachers in dyslexia identification
sponsored.sum: Requires training of teachers in dyslexia identification created by the center for dyslexia and dysgraphia.

sponsored.t: Relates to the final average salary calculation for Triborough bridge and tunnel members
sponsored.sum: Provides for an alternate final average salary calculation for Triborough bridge and tunnel members where such calculation includes certain dates.

sponsored.t: Relates to retirement eligibility for certain members
sponsored.sum: Provides for retirement without reduction of their retirement benefit upon attainment of at least fifty-five years of age and completion of thirty or more years of service for certain retirement system members.

sponsored.t: Provides for salary schedule parity
sponsored.sum: Provides for salary schedule parity for positions designated managerial or confidential with comparable union-represented positions.

sponsored.t: Provides for longevity payments for certain state employees
sponsored.sum: Provides for annual longevity payments for certain state employees designated managerial or confidential.

sponsored.t: Relates to procedures and other matters related to the receipt or discontinuation of certain benefits
sponsored.sum: Requires that all procedures and other matters related to the receipt or discontinuation of benefits available under section two hundred seven-c of the general municipal law shall be subject, upon request of the affected employee, to a de novo evidentiary hearing.
sponsored.fis: Minimal; hearings are already part of due process obligations and will help municipalities avoid litigation costs.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing geographic pay differentials for certain police officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing geographic pay differentials for certain police officers; authorizes a pay differential for regional state park police, forest ranger, environmental conservation officer, and university police officer titles when wage rates of police officers in a given location are substantially higher than the wage rates paid by the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of a twenty-two and one-half year retirement program for emergency medical technicians
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of a twenty-two and one-half year retirement program for members of the New York city employees' retirement system employed as emergency medical technicians and advanced emergency medical technicians and to the establishment of such program for such members who are subject to articles 11 and 15 of the retirement and social security law.

sponsored.t: Exempts unpaid student interns from coverage under workers' compensation
sponsored.sum: Exempts unpaid student interns from coverage under workers' compensation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the retirement contributions of career public employees
sponsored.sum: Provides for new retirement contribution rates of certain public employees.

sponsored.t: Relates to service rendered by police officers in the agency police services unit
sponsored.sum: Relates to service rendered by police officers in the agency police services unit.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for ordinary disability benefits and re-employment of disability retirees of the New York city police pension fund Tier III plans
sponsored.sum: Modifies eligibility for ordinary disability benefits and re-employment of disability retirees of the New York city police pension fund Tier III plans.

sponsored.t: Provides for benefits for certain emergency medical technicians in the city of New York who suffer any condition or impairment of health caused by a stroke resulting in disability or death
sponsored.sum: Provides for benefits for certain emergency medical technicians or advanced emergency medical technicians in the city of New York who suffer any condition or impairment of health caused by a stroke resulting in disability or death.

sponsored.t: Relates to the additional member contributions required of certain EMTs in the twenty-five year retirement program
sponsored.sum: Places limits on the additional member contributions required of certain EMTs in the twenty-five year retirement program.

sponsored.t: Provides a lung disease presumption for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors
sponsored.sum: Provides a lung disease presumption for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors.

sponsored.t: Provides that New York city correction officers may file for disability without ten years of service
sponsored.sum: Provides that New York city correction officers may file for disability without ten years of service.

sponsored.t: Relates to directing the metropolitan transportation authority to establish a city university of New York student fare program
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to establish a city university of New York student fare program for trains and buses which provides a full fare reduction for five train and/or bus fares each weekday equal to the standard pay-per-ride fare.

sponsored.t: Relates to surcharges for the installation or use of certain appliances in housing accommodations subject to rent control and rent stabilization
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the imposition of any surcharge for the installation or use of a tenant-installed appliance where the tenant pays for electric utility service, under rent control, and rent stabilization laws.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability retirement benefits for the presumption of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis for paid members of a fire department in a city with a population of one million or more
sponsored.sum: Provides a performance of duty presumption for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis for paid members of a fire department in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to the retirement of county and municipal airport firefighters
sponsored.sum: Provides for an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for certain airport firefighters employed by a county or municipality.
sponsored.fis: Costs associated with the enhanced retirement benefit, including past service costs, will be borne entirely by the employer that elects to provide the benefit. The local fiscal impact will vary based on work- force composition, salary levels, and actuarial determinations by the retirement system.

sponsored.t: Provides for a twenty year retirement of county correction officers in Suffolk county
sponsored.sum: Provides for a twenty year retirement of county correction officers in Suffolk county.

sponsored.t: Relates to death benefits for members of the uniformed force of the New York city department of sanitation and members of the uniformed force of the New York city department of correction
sponsored.sum: Relates to death benefits for members of the uniformed force of the New York city department of sanitation and members of the uniformed force of the New York city department of correction; establishes that the beneficiaries of a member who would have been entitled to a service retirement benefit at the time of such member's death may elect to receive, in a lump sum, an amount payable which shall be equal to the pension reserve that would have been established had the member retired on the date of such member's death, or the value of the death benefit and the reserve-for-increased-take-home-pay, if any, whichever is greater.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement benefits for certain members of the New York city employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Provides that for New York city police/fire members, uniformed correction/sanitation revised plan and investigator revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

sponsored.t: Grants service credit to members of the uniformed correction force of the New York city department of correction covered by provisions of law for over 25 years
sponsored.sum: Grants service credit to members of the uniformed correction force of the New York city department of correction covered by provisions of law for over 25 years.

sponsored.t: Requires the inspection of certain non-fireproof buildings and compliance with the New York city housing maintenance code and the New York city construction codes
sponsored.sum: Requires the inspection of non-fireproof buildings in a city having a population of one million or more every three years; requires compliance with the New York city housing maintenance code and the New York city construction codes; requires those dwellings not in compliance with such code at the time of inspection to make repairs or improvements necessary to comply with such standards within six months of such inspection, or a lien shall be placed upon the dwelling.

sponsored.t: Provides WTC-related benefits to certain employees who worked at the Verrazano Bridge Toll Facility
sponsored.sum: Provides WTC-related benefits to certain employees who worked at the Verrazano Bridge Toll Facility.

sponsored.t: Restores the 20 year service retirement for certain New York city corrections officers and sanitation workers
sponsored.sum: Restores the 20 year service retirement for certain New York city corrections officers and sanitation workers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the treatment of prior service with certain agencies by the New York city police pension fund
sponsored.sum: Includes prior service with certain agencies in creditable service for the purposes of the New York city police pension fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing benefits payable by the correction officers' variable supplements fund to beneficiaries
sponsored.sum: Increases benefits payable by the correction officers' variable supplements fund to beneficiaries.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance carriers to provide access to underwriting models or granular claim data to the department of financial services
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance carriers to provide access to underwriting models or granular claim data to the department of financial services to evaluate underwriting practices and risk assessment methodologies.
sponsored.fis: None to the State. Insurers already maintain the formulas and data inputs required by this bill and use them in automated underwriting systems. The bill imposes no new actuarial or computational burden.

sponsored.t: Establishes language-specific civil service titles for customer-facing roles in state and local agencies
sponsored.sum: Establishes language-specific variants of existing customer-facing titles where high-need language thresholds are met.
sponsored.fis: Minimal. Costs are expected to be limited to examination adjustments and reporting functions and may be offset by improved service efficiency and reduced reliance on contracted interpretation services.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the New York power authority to supply electric energy to certain low-income households
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York power authority to supply electric energy to low-income households receiving assistance through the New York city human resources administration and the New York state office of temporary and disability assistance, and to designate such agencies and local social services districts as billing energy service companies.
sponsored.fis: This bill is designed to be cost-neutral to the state. Savings generated through the New York Power Authority's cost-based electricity supply model are reinvested into energy affordability programs, reducing down- stream expenditures related to arrears management, emergency assistance, and service shutoffs.

sponsored.t: Increases the unemployment insurance minimum weekly benefit amount
sponsored.sum: Provides that the unemployment insurance minimum weekly benefit amount shall be the greater of two hundred fifty dollars or fifteen percent of the state average weekly wage.

sponsored.t: Extends the duration of unemployment insurance benefits
sponsored.sum: Provides that unemployment insurance benefits shall not be paid in an amount greater than thirty times the claimant's weekly benefit rate in any benefit year, subject to certain exceptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the calculation of a claimant's weekly unemployment insurance benefit
sponsored.sum: Provides that a claimant's weekly unemployment insurance benefit shall be calculated based on such claimant's average weekly wage compared to the state average weekly wage.

sponsored.t: Provides for minimum wage requirements for miscellaneous industry workers and establishes a one fair wage reimbursement credit
sponsored.sum: Provides for minimum wage requirements for miscellaneous industry workers; establishes a one fair wage reimbursement credit.

sponsored.t: Relates to tampering with physical evidence and obstructing governmental administration
sponsored.sum: Includes a police or peace officer turning off their body camera or deleting a body camera recording in the crime of tampering with physical evidence and obstructing governmental administration.

sponsored.t: Relates to actions or proceedings involving section one of article nineteen of the state constitution
sponsored.sum: Sets the required venue for actions or proceedings involving section one of article nineteen of the state constitution.

sponsored.t: Relates to longevity bonuses for members of the uniformed service with the New York city fire department
sponsored.sum: Provides for salary bonuses for members of the uniformed service with the New York city fire department who retire with at least twenty-five, thirty or thirty-five years of service.

sponsored.t: Expands who may visit local correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Expands who may visit local correctional facilities to include persons and accompanying staff of the chief executive officer of a county, members of a county legislative body, mayor of the city of New York, New York city public advocate, New York city comptroller, and members of the New York city council.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring certain health insurance issuers to certify that at least a majority of prescription drug rebates are provided to patients at the point of sale
sponsored.sum: Requires certain health insurance issuers to certify that at least a majority of prescription drug rebates are provided to patients at the point of sale.

sponsored.t: Requires exit surveys for employees resigning from state civil service
sponsored.sum: Requires each agency to conduct exit surveys for employees resigning from state civil service; directs the state civil service commission to create an annual report on such surveys; exempts individual responses to exit surveys from the freedom of information law.

sponsored.t: Establishes an internationally trained physician licensure pathway program
sponsored.sum: Establishes an internationally trained physician licensure pathway program to allow qualified, foreign-trained physicians and physicians trained and/or licensed to practice medicine in a territory or possession of the United States to contribute to the healthcare system through supervised practice in designated shortage areas, ultimately leading to full licensure.
sponsored.fis: Minimal administrative costs anticipated for program oversight and reporting.

sponsored.t: Directs the chair of the board of trustees of the city university of New York shall conduct an audit of such university's participation in retirement systems
sponsored.sum: Directs the chair of the board of trustees of the city university of New York shall conduct an audit of such university's participation in retirement systems and issue a report thereon.

sponsored.t: Relates to employee representation of state employees designated managerial or confidential
sponsored.sum: Provides notification of employment or promotion of applicable employees to organizations of state employees designated managerial or confidential for purposes of employee representation in determining the terms and conditions of employment.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory contributions for members in the optional retirement program
sponsored.sum: Provides certain members of the optional retirement program with an additional three percent statutory state contribution for the members of the optional retirement program for employees of both the State University of New York and the City University of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to first grade firefighters and promotions from the firefighter rank
sponsored.sum: Provides for longevity bonuses relating to first grade firefighters and promotions from the firefighter rank.

sponsored.t: Relate to service retirement of members of the New York city fire department pension fund
sponsored.sum: Removes the twenty-five year requirement for tier three escalation for service retirement of members of the New York city fire department pension fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement of members of the New York city fire department pension fund
sponsored.sum: Provides that full escalation date means the first day of the month following the date on which a member completes or would have completed twenty-three years of credited service, with respect to service retirement benefits for uniformed members of the New York city fire department pension fund.

sponsored.t: Imposes a special tax on artwork, antique furniture, and antique jewelry sold at auction and establishes the art education fund
sponsored.sum: Imposes a special tax of three-tenths of one percent or one dollar, whichever is greater, on the receipts from the sale of art, antique furniture or antique jewelry at auction; establishes the art education fund to provide assistance for art education and art supplies at the kindergarten through twelfth grade levels at Title I public schools.

sponsored.t: Provides a heart disease presumption for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors
sponsored.sum: Provides a heart disease presumption for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors.

sponsored.t: Relates to the retirement of correction officers of the Westchester county correction department
sponsored.sum: Establishes a thirty-year retirement benefit for correction officers of the Westchester county correction department.

sponsored.t: Relates to retirement benefits for certain employees
sponsored.sum: Relates to the election of retirement benefits for certain members of the New York state and local employees' retirement system who are employed by the office of mental health.

sponsored.t: Relates to accidental disability retirement for sheriffs
sponsored.sum: Relates to accidental disability retirement for sheriffs; provides that sheriffs shall receive a pension of three-quarters of their final average salary.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a thirty year retirement benefit for certain members in Nassau county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a thirty year retirement benefit for certain members in Nassau county; provides a retirement allowance equal to 60 percent of a member's final average salary.

sponsored.t: Grants members of the city of New York's police force eligibility for retirement and pension based on previous service as traffic enforcement agents
sponsored.sum: Grants members of the city of New York's police force eligibility for retirement and pension based on previous service as traffic enforcement agents.

sponsored.t: Relates to hearing procedures for certain public employees
sponsored.sum: Relates to hearing procedures for certain public employees; provides that the recommendation of a hearing officer in relation to designated managerial and confidential employees shall be considered final and not subject to change or modification.

sponsored.t: Increases the length of the term of office to four years for members of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Increases the length of the term of office to four years for members of the legislature.

sponsored.t: Grants the legislature to have an equal role with the governor in the budget process
sponsored.sum: Provides that the Governor's annual budget proposal to the Legislature shall include statements of any new legislation, amendment to legislation, or limitation on the effect of any legislation contained in the budget; makes related provisions granting the legislature an equal role with the governor in the budget process.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability benefits for certain deputy sheriff members in the sheriff's department of a city with a population of one million or more
sponsored.sum: Provides a presumption for accidental disability benefits for certain deputy sheriff members in the sheriff's department of a city with a population of one million or more who in performance of their duties contract human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), tuberculosis or hepatitis.

sponsored.t: Provides a heart disease presumption for certain members employed by the Triborough bridge and tunnel authority
sponsored.sum: Provides a heart disease presumption for members employed by the Triborough bridge and tunnel authority as a bridge and tunnel officer, sergeant or lieutenant in a non-managerial position.

sponsored.t: Provides a disability presumption to members of public retirement systems
sponsored.sum: Provides that a member of a public retirement system who has been determined to have a permanent partial disability by the workers' compensation board of the state of New York, and who the United States social security administration has determined is disabled for substantial gainful activity, and approved for social security disability benefits, shall be deemed to be disabled for the purposes of eligibility for disability benefits of such public retirement system.

sponsored.t: Relates to hearing officers
sponsored.sum: Expands the authority of hearing officers regarding judgments about an employee's inability to perform their duties due to a disability to be provided to the employee and the authorized representative of such employee.

sponsored.t: Relates to procedures to be followed in appointing a hearing officer for removal and disciplinary action against certain public employees
sponsored.sum: Provides procedures to be followed in appointing a hearing officer for removal and disciplinary action against certain public employees not in the service of the city of New York, including the fees to be paid for such hearing officer; provides for suspension, with pay, pending the determination.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain off-site custom fabrication public works projects and the payment of prevailing wage
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the definition of custom fabrication for the purposes of prevailing wage; requires certain reports for public works contracts including such custom fabrication.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effectiveness of provisions of law which requires appointing authorities to provide appointment and promotion letters
sponsored.sum: Relates to the effectiveness of provisions of law which requires appointing authorities to provide appointment and promotion letters when extending an offer of appointment or promotion to a position in the classified service.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority to develop a temporary middle income home energy assistance program; suspend taxes on home heating fuels; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority to develop, implement, administer and operate a temporary middle income home energy assistance program; suspends certain taxes on home heating fuels; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Allows beneficiaries of certain deceased members to elect to receive death benefits in a lump sum
sponsored.sum: Allows a beneficiary of a member whose death occurs on or after July 1, 2026 and who would have been entitled to a service credit at the time of such member's death to elect to receive a lump sum payment equal to the pension reserve that would have been established had the member retired on the date of such member's death.

sponsored.t: Sets the increase to the overtime ceiling as a fixed percentage
sponsored.sum: Sets the increase to the overtime ceiling as a fixed percentage.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the tenants' bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Requires a notice informing tenants of their rights to be provided to tenants at the time they execute a residential lease and to be posted in certain buildings.

sponsored.t: Requires fire-resistant material applicators to undergo training and certification
sponsored.sum: Requires fire-resistant material applicators to undergo training and certification; imposes fines for violations.

sponsored.t: Provides for tuition assistance program awards for students experiencing homelessness
sponsored.sum: Expands tuition assistance program awards for students experiencing homelessness.

sponsored.t: Relates to school climate and codes of conduct on school property and disciplinary action following violation of such codes of conduct; and makes conforming amendments
sponsored.sum: Relates to school climate and codes of conduct on school property and disciplinary action following violation of such codes of conduct; makes conforming amendments.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing a civil action for deprivation of rights
sponsored.sum: Provides a civil action for deprivation of rights which is caused by any person or public entity.

sponsored.t: Provides access to clean water for public employees
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of general services to ensure clean, safe drinking water is available in easily accessible locations for all public employees in state office buildings.
sponsored.fis: Minimal. Potential savings in long-term waste management costs due to reduced single-use plastic bottle consumption.

sponsored.t: Requires certain public schools in N.Y. city to offer Halal food options during lunch
sponsored.sum: Requires public schools in any city with a population over one million to offer Halal food options during lunch.

sponsored.t: Relates to recovery of alleged overpayment of wages
sponsored.sum: Establishes a minimum threshold of five hundred dollars for recovery of overpayment of wages; provides an employee who is alleged to have been overpaid notice and an opportunity to respond to such allegation prior to the state seeking such recovery.

sponsored.t: Requires a traffic study as part of an application to establish a charter school
sponsored.sum: Requires a traffic study that evaluates the potential impact of the proposed charter school on traffic patterns, safety and congestion in the surrounding area as part of an application to establish a charter school.

sponsored.t: Requires quarterly reporting on the amounts awarded and received from the opioid stewardship fund
sponsored.sum: Requires quarterly reporting on the opioid stewardship fund, including the names of the recipients and the amounts awarded and received.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of New York to provide for certain residential parking permit systems
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of New York to provide for certain residential parking permit systems in certain neighborhoods, including but not limited to, Washington Heights, Harlem, Morningside Heights, Upper West Side, East Harlem, and Upper East Side.

sponsored.t: Enacts the housing development fund company fairness, preservation, and affordability act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the housing development fund company fairness, preservation, and affordability act to clarify certain provisions relating to the dissolution and reincorporation of housing development fund companies; provides for tax exemptions and abatements for housing development fund companies.

sponsored.t: Requires colleges and universities in the state to have education programs for prospective teachers, administrators, and counselors for teaching immigrant-origin students
sponsored.sum: Requires the city university of New York and state university of New York have education programs for prospective teachers, administrators, and counselors for teaching immigrant-origin students that promotes diversity, equity and inclusion, and is multilingual.

sponsored.t: Requires a review of school safety plans for traffic and transportation issues
sponsored.sum: Requires a local transportation regulatory agency to review school safety plans for traffic and transportation issues prior to the issuance of a building permit for a new school facility or the expansion or renovation of an existing school facility.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing and directing the metropolitan transportation authority to implement a free fare program for NYC firefighters on the LIRR
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the metropolitan transportation authority to implement a free fare program on the Long Island Rail Road for firefighters employed by the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the fines for parking violations
sponsored.sum: Increases the maximum amount of fines for parking violations from fifty dollars to sixty-five dollars for a first violation, eighty-five dollars for a second parking violation, and one hundred dollars for each subsequent violation.

sponsored.t: Establishes the disability benefits maximization and assistance program to assist eligible state retirees in obtaining certain disability benefits
sponsored.sum: Establishes the disability benefits maximization and assistance program to assist eligible state retirees in obtaining certain disability benefits; provides for the investing of any net savings realized by the program back into the New York state health insurance program for the purpose of eliminating or limiting the impact of any premium rate or other cost increases that would be the responsibility of an employee or retiree.
sponsored.fis: This legislation will generate an estimated $852,000 in savings for the State Financial Plan in the first year of operation, growing to annual savings of $42 million within 5 years of implementation. This legislation also could generate savings for local governments if the Commissioner elects to extend the program to local government reti- rees, as authorized to do in the bill.

sponsored.t: Directs the assignment of a personal identification number to each application for acceptance to the state university and the city university
sponsored.sum: Provides that each state and city college or university assign a personal identification number to each application for acceptance to be used during the admissions process in place of any other identifying information including names and addresses.

sponsored.t: Establishes equitable repair and maintenance standards for certain buildings
sponsored.sum: Establishes equitable repair and maintenance standards for mixed income residential buildings with twenty or more units to prevent the use of repair and maintenance services as a form of tenant harassment.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing medically accurate instruction regarding human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and acquired immune deficiency syndrome (AIDS)
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing medically accurate instruction regarding human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and acquired immune deficiency syndrome (AIDS) in all elementary and secondary schools.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "limited equity cooperative insurance captive authorization and county cap act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "limited equity cooperative insurance captive authorization and county cap act" to enable limited equity cooperatives in the state of New York to establish insurance captives to enhance their ability to manage risks, improve insurance coverage, and promote financial stability.

sponsored.t: Relates to abandoned vehicles
sponsored.sum: Increases the dollar value of abandoned vehicles which may be seized by a local authority.

sponsored.t: Provides that certain persons who are not residents of the state but who have resided in the state for a certain period of time shall be eligible for in-state tuition rates
sponsored.sum: Provides that certain persons who are not residents of the state but who have resided in the state for a certain period of time and meet certain criteria shall be eligible for in-state tuition rates.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory continuing education for teachers relating to immigrant focused trauma-informed practices
sponsored.sum: Requires continuing teacher and leader education to include courses, programs and activities related to immigrant focused trauma-informed practices to support students who are dealing with adverse childhood or adolescent experiences as a result of immigration status.

sponsored.t: Grants a retroactive parity payment to certain management and confidential retirees
sponsored.sum: Grants a retroactive parity payment to certain management and confidential retirees who retired between April 1, 2009 and March 31, 2015, not to exceed $5,000.

sponsored.t: Imposes a progressive income tax structure; repealer
sponsored.sum: Imposes a progressive income tax structure for high income taxpayers.

sponsored.t: Provides for comparable salary and other benefits for certain state employees
sponsored.sum: Provides for comparable salary and other benefits for state employees designated managerial or confidential to ensure such employees receive an increase in salary at least equal to the percentage of the general salary increases provided to employees in a bargaining unit that receives the highest percentage general salary increase and other benefits.

sponsored.t: Suspends all unnecessary travel to states that have discriminatory laws for access to women's reproductive health services
sponsored.sum: Suspends all unnecessary travel to states that have discriminatory laws for access to women's reproductive health services, including but not limited to, limitations on access to abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a central business district toll exemption for certain employees of the fire department of the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for employees of the fire department of the city of New York in the title of firefighter, fire marshal, marine engineer, pilot or wiper.

sponsored.t: Requires public elementary schools to start no earlier than eight a.m. and public secondary schools to start no earlier than eight thirty a.m.
sponsored.sum: Requires public elementary schools to start no earlier than eight a.m. and public secondary schools to start no earlier than eight thirty a.m.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "solar for schools act"; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Enacts the solar for schools act which provides grants for eligible school districts to purchase and install solar and geothermal power sources; defines terms; directs the New York state energy and research development authority to establish such grant program; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof; makes an appropriation therefor.
sponsored.fis: This bill allocates $500 million from the general fund for the solar for schools program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the employee status of an individual
sponsored.sum: Relates to the employee status of an individual; establishes criteria for determining whether labor or services performed for remuneration qualify as employment.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "education funding census update act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "education funding census update act"; updates the census numbers used to calculate certain education funding.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting people from civil arrest at certain locations
sponsored.sum: Protects people from civil arrest while within one thousand feet of a sensitive location, unless such civil arrest is supported by a judicial warrant or judicial order authorizing such civil arrest.

sponsored.t: Clarifies that the New York state health insurance program remains subject to certain provisions of the financial services law
sponsored.sum: Clarifies that the New York state health insurance program remains subject to certain provisions of the financial services law and coverage for usual and customary costs for out-of-network health care service.

sponsored.t: Preserves the ability of health care providers to access the independent dispute resolution process
sponsored.sum: Preserves the ability of health care providers to access the independent dispute resolution process.

sponsored.t: Relates to the compensation of certain emergency medical technicians who are providing emergency medical services, and their supervisors, during outbreaks of infectious diseases
sponsored.sum: Provides for a hazardous pay differential for certain emergency medical technicians who are providing emergency medical services, and their supervisors, during outbreaks of infectious diseases.

sponsored.t: Relates to promotions of police detectives, sergeants, and lieutenants for retirement purposes
sponsored.sum: Relates to promotions of police detectives, sergeants, and lieutenants for retirement purposes.

sponsored.t: Extends the pilot program to examine the effects of waiving the state civil service examination fee
sponsored.sum: Extends the pilot program to examine the effects of waiving the state civil service examination fee to December 31, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to waiving the earning limitations for retired sworn officers employed by a district attorney as investigators
sponsored.sum: Relates to waiving the earning limitations for retired sworn officers employed by a district attorney as investigators.
sponsored.fis: There is no cost to New York State.

sponsored.t: Removes eligibility or receipt of primary social security disability benefits as a condition for ordinary disability retirement for certain members
sponsored.sum: Removes eligibility or receipt of primary social security disability benefits as a condition for ordinary disability retirement for New York city enhanced plan members in active service who are not eligible for a normal retirement benefit and have completed five years or more of service.

sponsored.t: Authorizes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for uniformed court officers and peace officers employed by the unified court system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for uniformed court officers and peace officers employed by the unified court system.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement benefits for certain members of the New York city employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Relates to service retirement benefits for certain members of the New York city employees' retirement system; provides that for New York city uniformed correction/sanitation revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing certain cultural and religious observances as school holidays in certain districts
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, Diwali, Lunar New Year, Tihar, Bandi Chhor Divas and Onam as school holidays.

sponsored.t: Requires signage on state highways designating where there are zero-emission charging and refueling stations nearby
sponsored.sum: Requires signage on state highways designating where there is a zero-emission charging and refueling station that is open and available to the public within three miles of an exit or off-ramp.

sponsored.t: Relates to first aid instruction for students in grades nine through twelve
sponsored.sum: Requires high schools to teach first aid instruction to students in grades nine through twelve.

sponsored.t: Relates to requests for employee personnel records
sponsored.sum: Requires agencies and public employers to provide notice and a review period to employees whose personnel records have been provided pursuant to the state's freedom of information law.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a variable supplements fund for sanitation members of the New York city employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a variable supplements fund for sanitation members of the New York city employees' retirement system; creates a board to manage such fund and to make payments.

sponsored.t: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for certain emergency medical technicians and fire protection inspectors
sponsored.sum: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for certain emergency medical technicians and fire protection inspectors.

sponsored.t: Includes persons holding positions by appointment or employment in the organized militia of the state as public employees
sponsored.sum: Amends the definition of public employee to include persons holding positions by appointment or employment in the organized militia of the state.

sponsored.t: Grants court reporters peace officer status
sponsored.sum: Grants court reporters and senior court reporters of the unified court system peace officer status.

sponsored.t: Establishes maximum age requirements for New York city correctional officers
sponsored.sum: Establishes maximum age requirements for New York city correction officers; provides that the commissioner of correction shall not appoint a person as a correction officer if such person is more than thirty-five years of age as of the date of the applicant's appointment or eligibility to compete in a promotion examination.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of education to develop school health and mental health professionals to student ratios in public schools
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of education to develop school health and mental health professionals to student ratios in public schools for students who do not receive services pursuant to the individuals with disabilities education act.

sponsored.t: Updates provisions relating to dignity for all students
sponsored.sum: Updates provisions relating to dignity for all students including curriculum and teacher training requirements designed to prevent student suicide with a focus on LGBTQ students.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of tobacco products and vapor products within five hundred feet of a public or private school
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of tobacco products and vapor products within five hundred feet of a public or private school.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing fresh produce to food deserts in the state
sponsored.sum: Establishes in the department of agriculture and markets a program to purchase fresh produce from farms located in the state and distribute such produce to areas determined by the commissioner of agriculture and markets to be food deserts; promotes opportunities for farm ownership among under-represented farmers, including farmers who are black, indigenous, or people of color.

sponsored.t: Relates to affidavits of the lawful immigration status of certain students; repealer
sponsored.sum: Removes the affidavit of the lawful immigration status requirement for certain students.

sponsored.t: Relates to protections and rights afforded to delivery network company workers
sponsored.sum: Relates to protections and rights afforded to delivery network company (DNC) workers; requires DNCs to create internal procedures for workers to challenge deactivations; provides certain notice and other rights to workers to challenge deactivation both internally in a DNC and externally; allows the Department of Labor to investigate unwarranted deactivation of workers; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes a farm-to-school task force and requiring all public schools to provide fresh foods to students in a manner that supports local agriculture
sponsored.sum: Establishes a farm-to-school task force; directs the commissioner of education to develop a program to require all public schools to provide fresh foods to students in a manner that supports local agriculture and increases market opportunities for farmers from under-represented communities.

sponsored.t: Establishes a direct service professional credit and career ladder tuition assistance grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a direct service professional credit and career ladder tuition assistance grant program to develop training programs and improve existing workforce development programs for the purpose of training direct support professionals and establishing a career ladder for individuals working with individuals with developmental disabilities.

sponsored.t: Provides for student loan assistance for certain attorneys employed by political subdivisions of the state
sponsored.sum: Grants student loan forgiveness for certain municipal attorneys employed by political subdivisions of the state.

sponsored.t: Implements a students' bill of rights for city university of New York institutions
sponsored.sum: Implements a students' bill of rights for city university of New York institutions to guarantee certain rights to students at such institutions.

sponsored.t: Waives the central business district toll for New York city sheriffs, undersheriffs or deputy sheriffs acting in their official capacity
sponsored.sum: Waives the central business district toll for New York city sheriffs, undersheriffs or deputy sheriffs acting in their official capacity.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York state fair tenant credit reporting act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York state fair tenant credit reporting act to ensure that negative credit reporting by landlords can only occur under fair and transparent circumstances.

sponsored.t: Imposes an excise tax on the sale of ammunition to be deposited into the gun violence impact fund; establishing the gun violence impact fund
sponsored.sum: Imposes an excise tax on the sale of ammunition to be deposited into the gun violence impact fund; establishes the gun violence impact fund; authorizes the director of the office of victim services to administer grants from the gun violence impact fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting Eric's ID Law
sponsored.sum: Provides for the placement of a discreet nonapparent disability designation on non-driver identification cards, drivers' licenses and learners' permits; makes technical and conforming changes.

sponsored.t: Establishes security deposit options for certain tenants
sponsored.sum: Establishes security deposit options for certain tenants, including but not limited to, an option to pay any deposit or advance to rent or use residential real property or a dwelling unit.

sponsored.t: Creates the offense of operating as a major firearms trafficker
sponsored.sum: Establishes the class A-I felony of operating as a major firearms trafficker.

sponsored.t: Requires the incorporation of structured, explicit, language and evidence-based approaches to literacy instruction for prospective teachers
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of education to establish and enforce rules and regulations to incorporate at least a three credit course devoted to the instructional techniques necessary for effective literacy instruction which shall include delivering structured, systematic, explicit, evidence-based instruction aligned with the science of reading for prospective teachers.

sponsored.t: Authorizes NYC to impose a fee on motor vehicles from states which do not cooperate with the enforcement of certain traffic laws
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the imposition of a fifty dollar fee on vehicles entering NYC which are registered in states which do not cooperate with New York in the enforcement of traffic infractions through the use of photo-monitoring devices or signal monitoring systems.

sponsored.t: Establishes a private cause of action for certain violations regarding machine-guns, assault weapons, disguised guns, ghost guns, and unfinished frames or receivers
sponsored.sum: Establishes a private cause of action for certain violations regarding machine-guns, assault weapons, disguised guns, ghost guns, and unfinished frames or receivers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of accrued vacation time
sponsored.sum: Allows New York state employees to use accrued vacation time toward student loan payments; defines terms; requires the president of the civil service commission to promulgate necessary rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Extends the duration of tuition assistance awards to five years
sponsored.sum: Extends the duration of tuition assistance awards to five years.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for unemployment benefits for certain New York city emergency medical services personnel under quarantine for coronavirus (COVID-19)
sponsored.sum: Relates to eligibility for unemployment benefits for certain New York city emergency medical services personnel under quarantine for coronavirus (COVID-19); provides that such employees shall not be deprived of benefit payments by reason of COVID-19 quarantine.

sponsored.t: Relates to including comprehensive climate change risk analysis as part of every environmental assessment statement and requiring updates to rules and regulations regarding the state environmental quality review
sponsored.sum: Includes comprehensive climate change risk analysis as part of every environmental assessment statement; requires updates to rules and regulations regarding the state environmental quality review no less than every five years.

sponsored.t: Requires panic alarm systems in schools
sponsored.sum: Provides that each public elementary and secondary school building shall be equipped with at least one panic alarm for use in a school security emergency including, but not limited to, a non-fire evacuation, lockdown, or active shooter situation; defines terms; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Restores the 20 year service retirement for certain New York city corrections officers
sponsored.sum: Restores the 20 year service retirement for certain New York city corrections officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing pension benefits to the widow of deceased firefighter Derek Floyd
sponsored.sum: Provides New York city fire pension fund benefits to the widow of deceased firefighter Derek Floyd.

sponsored.t: Replaces instances of the words or variations of the words American Indian with the words Indigenous peoples or a variation thereof
sponsored.sum: Replaces instances of the words or variations of the words American Indian with the words Indigenous peoples or a variation thereof.

sponsored.t: Directs the division of housing and community renewal to study non-rental fees charged by landlords
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of housing and community renewal to study non-rental fees charged by landlords and report to the legislature.

sponsored.t: Requires reporting to the federal bureau of investigation's national use-of-force data collection program
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of criminal justice services to report to the federal bureau of investigation's national use-of-force data collection program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the investment of funds wagered on video lottery gaming for certain horse races; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the investment of funds wagered on video lottery gaming for certain horse races.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax abatement for facilty-integrated carbon-to-value equipment
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax abatement for facility-integrated carbon-to-value equipment in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to compliance with substantially equivalent education by nonpublic schools
sponsored.sum: Requires compliance with substantially equivalent education by nonpublic schools; outlines new requirements.

sponsored.t: Prohibits legacy preference as eligible criteria for admission standards
